question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Fade
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 (Appear)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Fade"** means to gradually lose brightness, color, or visibility; to become less distinct or disappear over time. (मुरझाना/धुंधला होना)
 
 
• **Example:** The colors of the painting started to fade after being exposed to sunlight for years.
 
 
 
• **"Appear"** means to come into view, to become visible, or to emerge. It is the opposite of fading, as it refers to something becoming clearer or more distinct. (उभरना/दिखाई देना)
 
 
• **Example:** The stars begin to appear as the sky turns dark.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'fade'** is **'appear'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (Appear)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Achieve** (हासिल करना): To successfully reach a goal or objective through effort.
 
 
• **Example:** He worked hard to achieve his dream of becoming a doctor.
 
 
 
• **Accept** (स्वीकार करना): To agree to take something or to approve of it.
 
 
• **Example:** She decided to accept the job offer despite its challenges.
 
 
 
• **Admire** (प्रशंसा करना): To regard someone or something with respect or warm approval.
 
 
• **Example:** Everyone admires her dedication to her work.
